title: Shrine of Remulos
wikitext:
[[File:Shrine of Remulos.jpg|thumb|The Shrine of Remulos.]]

The '''Shrine of Remulos''' is a shrine dedicated to [[Keeper Remulos]], located in western [[Moonglade]]. It also houses the [[night elf]] [[Tajarri]], who helps young [[druid]]s along in their quest for the [[aquatic form]].
